meta.title: ReelForge
meta.description: Turns a novel into per-chapter short dramas inside DSH: context bible, 10 asset classes, reference assembly, five generation kinds across local and cloud, per-chapter delivery with three-level rollback.

workbench.title: ReelForge Workbench
workbench.subtitle: Chapters, shots, assets, context, skills, output, log
workbench.chapterUnit: One chapter is one independently deliverable episode.

ui.title: ReelForge Workbench
ui.subtitle: Chapters · Shots · Assets · Context · Skills · Output · Log
ui.empty.chapters: No chapters yet. Import a novel and it splits them for you.
ui.empty.shots: No shots yet. Run the llm stage to write the storyboard.
ui.empty.assets: No assets yet. Run the image stage to produce reference images.
ui.empty.context: Context is empty. Save a bible, a style guide or a continuity record.
ui.empty.skills: No skill installed. Install a skill pack, or generate one.
ui.empty.output: No output yet. Assemble a chapter to get a film.
ui.empty.hint: Ask the assistant in the conversation to take the next step.
ui.hardDependency: video hard-depends on image: missing reference images are an error.
ui.softDependency: video soft-depends on tts: missing voices degrade the video and the UI says so.
ui.skills.emptyDescription: An empty description disables both routing and the skill directory.
ui.skills.notDistributed: The plugin ships no third-party skill bodies; install upstream packs yourself.
ui.chapter.unit: A chapter is one independently deliverable unit — one episode per chapter.
ui.shots.assembly: Assembly order: character → scene → prop → voice · images ≤9, media ≤3
ui.assets.priority: Reference priority: costume > age variant > character (independent axes)
ui.assets.variants: Variant classes (costume / age) must carry parent_id and hang under the parent
ui.context.keys: Context allows exactly three keys; an extra key is an error, never a silent drop
ui.deliver.binaryKept: Media binaries are not deleted by a rollback (video and images stay in place)
ui.log.drifted: This record drifted; rolling back overwrites later changes
ui.log.timepoint: Roll back to a point in time
